raw_text: DFRLab analysis of the Niger coup information environment reveals a coordinated amplification campaign across X, Telegram, and Facebook. We identified 847 accounts exhibiting inauthentic coordinated behavior, including synchronized posting times, shared hashtags (#NigerLibre #FranceDehors), and cross-platform content duplication. At least 23% of these accounts were created within 72 hours of the coup. The narrative campaign focused on three themes: anti-France sentiment, pro-sovereignty framing, and discrediting ECOWAS intervention threats.
clean_text: DFRLab identified 847 accounts in coordinated amplification campaign around Niger coup. 23% created within 72 hours. Campaign themes: anti-France, pro-sovereignty, discrediting ECOWAS.
